_comment: Installed by scripts/terminal.sh as a symlink into
up automatically; your own profiles are never touched.
No 'Dynamic Profile Parent Name' is set on purpose: a dynamic profile with no
declared parent inherits from your *default* profile, so colours, window size
and everything else stay exactly as you configured them. Only the keys below
'Bound Hosts' drives Automatic Profile Switching. An entry prefixed with '&'
matches the foreground job name, so this profile activates only while nvim is
running and reverts the moment it exits -- which is what keeps Cmd+C from
sending SIGINT at a shell prompt. APS requires iTerm2 Shell Integration.
Keyboard Map keys are 'keycode-modifiers'. Printable keys use the character
code with an 0x prefix (0x73 = 's'); function keys use their bare NSEvent
code (f702 = left arrow, f703 = right arrow). Modifier mask bits:
0x100000 Command   0x200000 NumericPad (always set for arrow keys)
Action 10 = Send Escape Sequence (Text is what follows ESC),
Action 11 = Send Hex Code (Text is a space separated list of bytes).
